rules.description: The service layer must not depend directly on a persistence implementation (JDBC, JPA or Spring Data JPA classes); it must use the repository interfaces.
rules.rationale: The readme documents three interchangeable persistence implementations selected by Spring profile. A direct service-to-implementation dependency would tie the service to one implementation and break that documented design.

rules.description: Controllers (REST controllers in rest, or Spring MVC controllers in web) must not depend directly on the persistence layer (repository interfaces or implementations); they must go through the service layer.
rules.rationale: The readme layer table orders REST API controllers above the Service layer. The project history states the rule explicitly: commit a994785f73a848058a4bad7b5bb2ef00f1b2fa2c 'made sure the ClinicService facade is used by all Controllers'.

rules.description: Model (domain entity) classes must not depend on the presentation, service or persistence layers.
rules.rationale: Entities are shared by every layer; a dependency from model to a higher layer would create a cycle between layers.
